result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot CRM** as the best all-around starting point. It's relatively easy to use, has a generous free option, and can grow with your business.

However, the best CRM depends on how your team manages customers, sales, and follow-ups.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free plan available for up to 2 users.
- Contact and deal management.
- Email tracking and sales pipeline.
- Marketing and customer service integrations.

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one platform.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very intuitive visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks deals and follow-ups.
- Sales activity reminders.
- Easy to see where every opportunity stands.

Best for teams focused on closing deals.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![The Best CRM Software for Designers, Artists & Real Estate Agents](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VIaaVCsbSl_2HEhaNS7jaJq8M_qMRSRNnjnm4ih0BS1XW1i1dLOL1hzUuJbbQAd2oJmyek348JWDCbhZ4_llPc5MXQMU75Xd7mDacN4WycxgUOxd_i41eEMQmIEsUk3gC2v6kQv05B-0CnauDSxnGfZTdYq_06PA6HE7PRmCp51gbAogWba4zKaxdqnPKpN-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Free plan for up to 3 users.
- Strong workflow automation.
- Custom fields and reporting.
- Integrates with the Zoho ecosystem.

Best for affordability and customization.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Affordable entry-level paid plans.
- Built-in email, phone and chat features.
- Lead scoring and automation.
- Good sales management features.

Best for teams that communicate with lots of prospects.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rL9Bzm932Es-G8eSD-IugxH25VpIFj2GrnbBExwUqA2Nr3S2F-13Q2QUuWHSsw5hSYAN9ENyOY_MTevU9OZtOiwp-cUhvAnLAqY_40r6pFQsW3KxPgFxL3JCosxfn4L6Jfwp2NCZNME-i2pDOLdg2P_TmFE26A6QIif7ztMuqYUxcMfuJMeKmmPBjbxzqwot?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Visual dashboards and workflows.
- Customizable sales processes.
- Team collaboration and task tracking.
- Connects customer management with operations.

Best for teams managing projects alongside customers.

[Explore monday CRM](https://monday.com/crm)
